limitations: Local-only verification; no network, browser, source-page revisit, live deployment, publication, or online retrieval was performed.

Deterministic bytes are established for the recorded current Python/openpyxl toolchain, not promised across arbitrary future library versions.
Roster records and raw source observations are not unique-person or confirmed-current-employment totals. Selected profiles remain partial professional evidence, not complete school coverage.
No remote write, publication, deployment or live-site verification. The controller separately reviews and decides publication.
